---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a feature or improvement to an existing sim
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

**Sim affected**
Which simulation does this enhance? (For new sims, use the "Sim proposal" template instead.)

**What you'd like**
A clear and concise description of the feature or improvement.

**Why**
Why this is valuable. What problem does it solve, or what does it enable?

**Sketch of approach (optional)**
If you have an idea of how to implement this, describe it briefly.

**References**
Papers, demos, or prior art relevant to this feature.
